name: Захист (2)
description: The art of good defense lies in careful calculation. Examine your opponent's threats and look for ways to neutralize them. Try to place your king and pieces safely so you don't lose material.

examples.text: By advancing the c-pawn, the check is lifted, and the white knight is suddenly defended.
Advancing the f-pawn is the only way to save the rook without losing material.

texts: Defend against the check without losing material.
